scope: Account Connect redesign, six product views across four providers

providers.current: PoeQuotaAdapter reads combined remaining points; PoeUsageHistory handles bounded pages; PoeOAuthAttempt already prepares PKCE/state and key-expiry parsing. Current generic account wizard still expects one manually pasted key, plan choice and optional model selection. Host OAuth callback/exchange/persistence absent. This does not support a genuine catalog/plan/template-independent monitor-only connection.
